variants.label: Nominal
variants.description: The reference motor: 48 V, 55 A, with the same task sequence used for every design.

result.controller: Differential IK with bounded FOC arm actuators; 30 N implicit linear gripper drives

variants.observed: The reference passes all four measured stages, including a right-only handoff and contact-free placement.

variants.label: High Kv rewind
variants.description: Twice the Kv, half the Kt. Fewer turns reduce winding resistance and inductance; the inverter current limit stays fixed.

result.controller: Differential IK with bounded FOC arm actuators; 30 N implicit linear gripper drives

variants.observed: The task stays inside this motor's limits. Peak torque current is 33.3 A; the cube trajectory matches the nominal recording.

variants.label: Very high Kv rewind
variants.description: Four times the Kv, one quarter of the Kt. The fixed 55 A inverter now provides only a quarter of nominal peak torque.

result.controller: Differential IK with bounded FOC arm actuators; 30 N implicit linear gripper drives

variants.observed: The cube is placed, but the worst final arm pose misses its command by 185 mm. Peak current reaches 55.0 A.

variants.label: Low Kv rewind
variants.description: Half the Kv, twice the Kt. More turns increase winding resistance and inductance and reduce the available speed.

result.controller: Differential IK with bounded FOC arm actuators; 30 N implicit linear gripper drives

variants.observed: The task stays inside this motor's limits. Peak torque current is 8.3 A; the cube trajectory matches the nominal recording.

variants.label: Current-limited motor
variants.description: A 6.6 A inverter limit gives only 12% of nominal peak joint torque. This deliberately tests inadequate torque authority.

result.controller: Differential IK with bounded FOC arm actuators; 30 N implicit linear gripper drives

variants.observed: The arm loses control before grasping and knocks the cube off the table. Cooling is not the limiting factor in this run.

variants.label: Heavier arm hardware
variants.description: Adds 2 kg to each of seven moving arm links: 14 kg per arm. Rigid-body mass and inertia both change.

result.controller: Differential IK with bounded FOC arm actuators; 30 N implicit linear gripper drives

variants.observed: The task still completes. Peak torque rises to 89.1 N·m and the hottest winding reaches 33.0 °C.

variants.label: Hot start
variants.description: The same motor starts at 125 °C. Copper resistance, magnet strength and thermal current derating change together.

result.controller: Differential IK with bounded FOC arm actuators; 30 N implicit linear gripper drives

variants.observed: Starts at 125 °C and still completes this task. Peak torque current rises to 18.6 A as the hotter motor's magnet flux falls.

variants.label: Low bus voltage
variants.description: A 6 V supply reduces voltage headroom and available torque at speed. This is an undervoltage stress test.

result.controller: Differential IK with bounded FOC arm actuators; 30 N implicit linear gripper drives

variants.observed: At this slow motion, even the 6 V bus stays within its voltage limit. The recorded trajectory matches nominal; high-speed capability is not established.
